title: Verb + -ing (gerund)
en:
Use the -ing form:

1. As the subject of a sentence: Testing controls takes time. Learning English is important for me.

2. After prepositions: I'm good at solving problems. Thank you for helping. Before leaving, check the door. I'm interested in working abroad. I'm looking forward to meeting you.

3. After these verbs: enjoy, like, love, hate, don't mind, finish, stop, avoid, spend (time), feel like, can't stand, keep, suggest: I enjoy working with people. I avoid making decisions in a hurry.

Compare 7A: I want to go but I enjoy going.
ru: Форма -ing: 1) как подлежащее (Learning English is important); 2) после предлогов (good at, interested in, thank you for, before / after, look forward to + -ing!); 3) после глаголов enjoy, like, love, hate, don't mind, finish, stop, avoid, spend time, feel like, can't stand, keep, suggest.

boss.situation: Write about what you enjoy, avoid and look forward to in your job. Use at least 5 different -ing structures.
samples: I enjoy working with people from different departments.
I'm good at finding mistakes in documents.
I avoid making promises I cannot keep.
Testing controls takes a lot of time, but it is interesting.
I'm looking forward to working for an international company.
